messages.subject: Question of R-INLA-SPDE Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
parts:
Hello.

I am a new R user. Currently, I use R-INLA to make a SPDE model. And my code reference the book 《Beyesian inference with INLA》, the chapter 7.7.3(https://becarioprecario.bitbucket.io/inla-gitbook/ch-spatial.html#sec:geostats). I use 66 points to predict 268079 elements. The cellsize is 32*32。However, the console had the next message:

Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
 The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interrupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

I have no idea where is the problem. I attached the output.

Do you have any suggestion? I will be grateful to you If you can tell me! 

Thanks by your attention!

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Question of R-INLA-SPDE Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
